About me

From the lab to marketing, still curious.

I started out in biomedical engineering and malaria research, where I spent my days collecting data and figuring out what it meant. Somewhere along the way I realised I loved the other side too: telling stories, talking to people and helping good ideas reach the right audience.

Today I work across SEO, social media, content, email and analytics. I also run my own small drink brand, Nhaa's Kenkey Smoothie, so I know what it feels like when every sale counts.

My strengths

What I bring to the table

  • SEO & AEO

    Keyword research and on-page work that helps people actually find you. I've done this for brands like M-KOPA and Christopher John Rogers.

  • Content that sells

    Videos, flyers and captions written for real people. They helped move 500+ bottles of my own smoothie in three months.

  • Email marketing

    Planning, testing and automating campaigns in MailChimp that get opened and clicked.

  • Reading the numbers

    Years of research data work taught me to trust evidence. I track KPIs and let them guide the next move.

  • Social media

    Running pages, answering customers on WhatsApp and Instagram, and turning conversations into orders.

  • Teamwork under deadlines

    I've pitched strategies for 10+ real companies with mixed teams, and I like the pressure.

Brand Campaign

PwC - Expertise meets tech

Deloitte - Strategic sourcing in Industry 4.0

Print Ad

Trust was the whole message, so I kept it simple: one confident person, KPMG's signature blue and a headline you can't miss. Written in French for a Francophone audience.
